items.name: address-field
items.title: TonalDepth AddressField
items.description: A postal address in the order each line narrows the next.

items.name: alert
items.title: TonalDepth Alert
items.description: A typed TonalDepth persistent notice with info, success, warning, and error variants and an optional dismiss control.

items.name: application-shell
items.title: TonalDepth ApplicationShell
items.description: A typed TonalDepth application shell with grouped sidebar navigation, identity slot, main header, and content area.

items.name: article-card
items.title: TonalDepth ArticleCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth blog/article card: optional cover, category eyebrow, title, excerpt, an "In this piece" well of the tools, files and datasets the piece carries, an author and a date + read-time meta line, and an optional whole-card link that takes the depth ladder.

items.name: avatar
items.title: TonalDepth Avatar
items.description: A person at the size the row gives them: a photograph in a well, initials derived first-and-last when it is missing, and a presence lamp. AvatarGroup overlaps them so the row reads left to right.

items.name: badge
items.title: TonalDepth Badge
items.description: A typed TonalDepth status badge with neutral, brand, success, accent, and danger variants.

items.name: chip
items.title: TonalDepth Chip
items.description: A filter token — one applied value the reader can see and, when it can be retracted, remove with a raised × cap. The applied-filter counterpart to FilterBar's picker.

items.name: spinner
items.title: TonalDepth Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate busy indicator — a ring with a papaya arc that turns while something loads and no progress figure exists to show. Sized and labelled per instance.

items.name: segmented
items.title: TonalDepth Segmented
items.description: A single-select inline control — one choice from a small set of peers shown at once, the selected segment pressed into a recessed well. Day/week/month, sort order, light/dark/system.

items.name: ring
items.title: TonalDepth Ring
items.description: A determinate circular meter — the round sibling of Progress, with the papaya fill travelling the edge as light rather than a wedge of colour. Tones, sizing, and centred value.

items.name: popover
items.title: TonalDepth Popover
items.description: A click-triggered, non-modal panel of arbitrary content anchored to its trigger — toggles, closes on Escape and outside-click, manages focus, and carries role=dialog.

items.name: gauge
items.title: TonalDepth Gauge
items.description: A compact load meter — a strip of bars that rises with a value, coloured by band (low green, med accent, high brand), read against a label and a percentage.

items.name: uptime
items.title: TonalDepth UptimeBars
items.description: A status-page uptime strip — one row per service, a bar per interval coloured by state (up green, warn papaya, down deep), and the period's figure at the end.

items.name: undobar
items.title: TonalDepth UndoBar
items.description: The reversible-action bar — act first, then offer a way back. A papaya hairline drains and the action commits when it empties; Undo puts it back. No confirmation modal.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: TonalDepth InlineEdit
items.description: A value that turns into a field when clicked and back when you leave — edit a read-mostly detail in place. Commits on Enter or blur, discards on Escape.

items.name: carousel
items.title: TonalDepth Carousel
items.description: A horizontal scroll-snap strip of cards — a focusable region with a name, no prev/next to reimplement. Ships CarouselCard (eyebrow, title, body, CTA, tone).

items.name: drawer
items.title: TonalDepth Drawer
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from the edge — scrim, trapped focus, Escape and scrim-click to close, body scroll locked, portalled to the body. Left or right side.

items.name: bottom-nav
items.title: TonalDepth BottomNav
items.description: The bar of destinations under the thumb: four always present, the rest behind a More control that expands the bar upward into a sheet. Pins itself to the viewport and publishes `--bottom-nav-offset` so a page can clear it.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: TonalDepth Breadcrumbs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth breadcrumb trail in the three forms the design system draws — chevrons, slashes, and the condensed housed bar — on one separator prop.

items.name: button
items.title: TonalDepth Button
items.description: A typed TonalDepth action button with five variants, three sizes, and loading state.

items.name: card
items.title: TonalDepth Card
items.description: A typed TonalDepth surface with raised, flat, and inset depth treatments, header, title, and content slots.

items.name: case-card
items.title: TonalDepth CaseCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth case-study card: eyebrow, outcome title, summary, outcome metrics in mono, and an optional whole-card link that takes the depth ladder.

items.name: chart-container
items.title: TonalDepth ChartContainer
items.description: A typed TonalDepth chart figure with title, meta, hidden description for assistive tech, and optional legend.

items.name: chat-launcher
items.title: TonalDepth ChatLauncher
items.description: A typed TonalDepth floating chat launcher and panel, with a presence lamp and an optional revolving AI halo. Not a dialog: the page stays usable.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: TonalDepth Checkbox
items.description: A typed TonalDepth checkbox with an owned label and native input semantics.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: TonalDepth CheckboxGroup
items.description: Several checkboxes read as one question, in a fieldset with a legend.

items.name: code-block
items.title: TonalDepth CodeBlock
items.description: A typed TonalDepth code listing, housed in a Frame with a copy chip in the corner. It does no highlighting — pass pre-highlighted markup.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: TonalDepth ColorPicker
items.description: A colour from a curated palette, with the platform picker behind `allowCustom`.

items.name: combobox
items.title: TonalDepth Combobox
items.description: A filtered listbox with type-ahead, and the multi-select form on one `multiple` prop.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: TonalDepth ComparisonTable
items.description: A typed TonalDepth comparison table: criteria down, options across, booleans as marks with a text equivalent, and the argued-for column set as the ladder's selected step.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: TonalDepth ConfirmButton
items.description: A typed TonalDepth destructive action that asks once, in place. The first press arms it; the second, inside the timeout, commits.

items.name: copy-chip
items.title: TonalDepth CopyChip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth chip that puts a machine value on the clipboard. Success is reported in ink and glyph, never as a tinted plate.

items.name: counter
items.title: TonalDepth Counter
items.description: A typed TonalDepth statistic that counts up when it is scrolled to. The marketing form of KpiCard, with the plate taken away and the value at display size.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: TonalDepth CtaBanner
items.description: A typed TonalDepth closing call to action. It carries weight through depth and scale rather than a brand fill, and takes library Buttons in its actions slot.

items.name: data-list
items.title: TonalDepth DataList
items.description: A typed TonalDepth definition list for four to six fields about one record — where a table's header row would be overhead.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: TonalDepth DatePicker
items.description: One day, from a month grid that walks by arrow key and by month on PageUp.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: TonalDepth DateRangePicker
items.description: A span of days across one calendar, with quick spans for the questions readers actually ask.

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: TonalDepth DateTimePicker
items.description: A precise instant — the calendar and the time grid in one popover.

items.name: dialog
items.title: TonalDepth Dialog
items.description: A typed TonalDepth modal dialog with focus trapping, Escape and click-outside dismissal, header, description, and footer slots.

items.name: divider
items.title: TonalDepth Divider
items.description: The parting between two things, as a carved seam rather than a drawn line — the shade cut into the surface and the light catching the lip below. Horizontal, vertical, inset, or with words in it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: TonalDepth DropdownMenu
items.description: A typed TonalDepth dropdown menu with a single-selection menuitemradio list and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: faq
items.title: TonalDepth Faq
items.description: A typed TonalDepth question list that opens in place. Real buttons with aria-expanded, and answers hidden with `hidden` so they leave in-page search too.

items.name: feature-card
items.title: TonalDepth FeatureCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth feature card with an icon lamp, bullet points and a footer slot, plus a density-explicit grid. Tone moves the icon's ink, never a fill.

items.name: filament-button
items.title: TonalDepth FilamentButton
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tab button that reports its state with a lit filament rather than a fill. Four states — off, dim on hover, held, and brightest on press — along either the inline-start or the top edge.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: TonalDepth FilePreview
items.description: A typed TonalDepth document row: the preview in a well, the name, the facts and the actions on the plate beside it. Renders no PDF.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: TonalDepth FileTree
items.description: A typed TonalDepth repository or docs tree. Rows press rather than tint, and the chevron is a direction mark rather than a lamp.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: TonalDepth FileUpload
items.description: A dropzone with a keyboard path, size limits and a list of what has been picked; `preview` makes it an image upload.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: TonalDepth FilterBar
items.description: A typed TonalDepth multi-select filter chip row with per-chip count, disabled state, and clear-all action.

items.name: footer
items.title: TonalDepth Footer
items.description: The site footer, composed from a brand band, link columns, a contact well and a bottom rule. Server-renderable, so the whole link inventory stays in the crawled HTML.

items.name: form-field
items.title: TonalDepth FormField
items.description: A typed TonalDepth label, help text, error text, and control wrapper that wires ARIA relationships for any single child control.

items.name: frame
items.title: TonalDepth Frame
items.description: A raised plate with a well cut into it — the housing anything measured lives inside. Chrome is raised, data is recessed, so a chart or a table reads as data without a single border.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: TonalDepth IconButton
items.description: The lamp: a round icon-only button, or a pill with a label, whose icon carries the interaction state — unlit at rest, lit on hover, brighter on press — while the label holds its ink. Neutral, papaya, azure, invert and per-channel tones.

items.name: input
items.title: TonalDepth Input
items.description: A typed TonalDepth single-line text input with optional leading and trailing slots and an invalid state.

items.name: iso-stack
items.title: TonalDepth IsoStack
items.description: A typed TonalDepth deck of cards seen at an angle, which fans apart on hover and on focus. For where the count is the point and the entries are secondary.

items.name: kpi
items.title: TonalDepth KPI
items.description: A typed TonalDepth KPI card and responsive grid for eyebrow label, display value, trend delta, and optional sparkline.

items.name: link-cells
items.title: TonalDepth LinkCells
items.description: A typed TonalDepth grid of onward links. The whole cell is the target, so there is no separate read-more.

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: TonalDepth LogoStrip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth wall of real client artwork — monochrome at rest, full colour on hover, with each mark's name carried as its alternative text.

items.name: map
items.title: TonalDepth Map
items.description: A typed TonalDepth static locator map — a carved ground, an optional graticule and pins as lamps in sockets. No tile provider and no network call.

items.name: mega-cascade
items.title: TonalDepth MegaCascade
items.description: A typed TonalDepth three-level cascading mega panel — categories, subcategories, items — each column a well, with roving-tabindex rails. `megaCascadeSections` flattens the same groups for a NavDrawer.

items.name: mega-columns
items.title: TonalDepth MegaColumns
items.description: A typed TonalDepth wide mega panel: a feature panel that makes the case beside titled columns of destinations, with a footer rail.

items.name: mega-grid
items.title: TonalDepth MegaGrid
items.description: A typed TonalDepth mega panel of cards, housed in a well rather than sitting on the sheet, plus the footer action rail.

items.name: mega-tabs
items.title: TonalDepth MegaTabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth two-column mega panel: a rail of options on the left, one pane on the right.

items.name: multi-step
items.title: TonalDepth MultiStep
items.description: A typed TonalDepth form in panes, with the step indicator that belongs to it. It owns the position and nothing else — no validation, no values.

items.name: nav-drawer
items.title: TonalDepth NavDrawer
items.description: The navigation's small form: a sheet off the edge holding the SAME `items` array the bar holds, with a disclosure per menu and a row per flat link. Its own focus trap, scroll lock, Escape and dismissal, in React.

items.name: number-field
items.title: TonalDepth NumberField
items.description: A number with its two nudge buttons; a prefix or suffix makes it a currency or percent field.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: TonalDepth OtpInput
items.description: A one-time code, one cell per digit, with paste spread across the cells.

items.name: page-nav
items.title: TonalDepth PageNav
items.description: A typed TonalDepth secondary header — the horizontal bar under the site header that navigates within a page's section, sticky and scrolling on narrow screens.

items.name: page-patterns
items.title: TonalDepth PagePatterns
items.description: Typed TonalDepth page compositions: DashboardPage, DashboardPanel, DataManagementPage, PageState.

items.name: pagination
items.title: TonalDepth Pagination
items.description: A typed TonalDepth page trail with a truncating range. The page being read rests recessed with papaya ink rather than being filled with the brand colour.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: TonalDepth PhoneField
items.description: A phone number with a searchable country selector, reported as E.164.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: TonalDepth PricingTable
items.description: A typed TonalDepth plan grid — a price, what it includes, and the way to take it. The featured plan is reported by depth and papaya ink, never by a fill.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: TonalDepth ProfileCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth person card — the mark beside the name, or above it with a bio. One card for both the profile card and the team wall.

items.name: progress
items.title: TonalDepth Progress
items.description: A typed TonalDepth progress meter. The track is carved into the surface and the filled length is the only thing carrying colour, because it is a measured quantity.

items.name: prose
items.title: TonalDepth Prose
items.description: A typed TonalDepth long-form container that styles authored HTML — headings, lists, quotes, code, tables and rules — for articles, guides and legal pages.

items.name: radio
items.title: TonalDepth Radio
items.description: A typed TonalDepth radio and radio group that shares a name via context and honors fieldset disabled state.

items.name: range
items.title: TonalDepth Range
items.description: A typed TonalDepth slider on a carved track. A real input[type=range], so the keyboard and assistive technology behave natively.

items.name: range-dual
items.title: TonalDepth RangeDual
items.description: Range's two-thumb form — a span rather than a point, on two native inputs.

items.name: rating
items.title: TonalDepth Rating
items.description: Stars, read or set, with halves when read-only and arrow keys when not.

items.name: reading-progress
items.title: TonalDepth ReadingProgress
items.description: A typed TonalDepth reading indicator: the thin bar across the top of the viewport that reports how far into a piece the reader has come. Progress with the label, the percentage and the track taken away, and a scroll position it works out for itself.

items.name: rect-title
items.title: TonalDepth RectTitle
items.description: A typed TonalDepth rectangle title. It splits a headline into balanced lines and scales each one so the block squares off, in the display face at h1 to h3.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: TonalDepth SearchBar
items.description: A typed TonalDepth search field, carved into the surface rather than raised, with an optional suggestion listbox following the ARIA combobox pattern.

items.name: select
items.title: TonalDepth Select
items.description: A native select in the system's housing — the platform picker and its keyboard, with the design system's carve.

items.name: side-tabs
items.title: TonalDepth SideTabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth sideways tab set built on the filament. Vertical with labels, collapsed to a glyph rail, or laid horizontally for mobile, with the full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard pattern.

items.name: site-navigation
items.title: TonalDepth SiteNavigation
items.description: The marketing site navigation — a raised pill that sticks flush, retracts on the way down and returns on the way up, with mega panels held at one size whatever they hold. Draws its own burger below 900px; `nav-drawer` is what that burger opens. Publishes `--nav-offset` for in-page sticky toolbars.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: TonalDepth Skeleton
items.description: The shape of content that has not arrived, carved at the depth the real thing will sit at. Reports itself once for the region rather than once per bar.

items.name: social-button
items.title: TonalDepth SocialButton
items.description: A social link as its own logo — an icon-only control whose housing carries the platform's colour. Eighteen marks built in, from Simple Icons.

items.name: split-button
items.title: TonalDepth SplitButton
items.description: A typed TonalDepth split button: one action with its alternatives folded behind a disclosure. Defaults to an action, or withholds it until the reader chooses when the choice is load-bearing.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: TonalDepth Spotlight
items.description: A typed TonalDepth command palette: a search field over the whole product, on a scrim. It does no matching — the caller owns ranking.

items.name: sub-nav
items.title: TonalDepth SubNav
items.description: A typed TonalDepth grouped link list with counts — second-level navigation inside a section of a product. ApplicationShell renders this component for its sidebar.

items.name: switch
items.title: TonalDepth Switch
items.description: A typed TonalDepth toggle switch backed by a role=switch checkbox with an owned label.

items.name: table
items.title: TonalDepth Table
items.description: A typed TonalDepth semantic table set (container, table, head, body, row, header cell, data cell) with responsive containment.

items.name: tabs
items.title: TonalDepth Tabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tab list and single tab panel with arrow-key navigation and controlled or uncontrolled selection.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: TonalDepth TagInput
items.description: Free-text tags in a carved well, committed on Enter and taken back on Backspace.

items.name: terminal
items.title: TonalDepth Terminal
items.description: A typed TonalDepth transcript of something that ran, housed in a well. Not CodeBlock: a code block is source you copy and run, this is the record of a run you read.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: TonalDepth Testimonial
items.description: A typed TonalDepth quotation with its attribution. Not ProfileCard: the subject is the claim, and the person is the evidence for it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: TonalDepth Textarea
items.description: A typed TonalDepth multi-line text area matched to the Input treatment.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: TonalDepth ThemeToggle
items.description: The system's theme switch — a round icon button whose sun and moon are lamps. It keeps `data-theme` stamped on the document, including in the unstamped system state, and remembers the choice.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TonalDepth TimePicker
items.description: A time of day from hour and minute grids — two presses, nothing to scroll.

items.name: timeline
items.title: TonalDepth Timeline
items.description: A typed TonalDepth ordered sequence for phases, process and roadmaps. State reads from the dot's depth, and the current phase is announced in text.

items.name: toast
items.title: TonalDepth Toast
items.description: A typed TonalDepth toast provider and hook that queues info, success, and error notifications with auto-dismiss.

items.name: toc
items.title: TonalDepth TableOfContents
items.description: A typed TonalDepth on-this-page rail. The seam is a filament: always present, off and grey, and the current section lights its own segment.

items.name: tokens
items.title: TonalDepth Tokens
items.description: The shared TonalDepth CSS custom properties and body defaults. Install this once, then TonalDepth components stop redeclaring the same tokens.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: TonalDepth Tooltip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tooltip that wraps a single child element and reveals a positioned tip on hover, focus, or open prop.

items.name: whatsapp-form
items.title: TonalDepth WhatsAppForm
items.description: A WhatsApp enquiry: a button that opens a short form and hands the finished message to WhatsApp, addressed to one number. Nothing is submitted anywhere.

items.name: window-controls
items.title: TonalDepth WindowControls
items.description: The three window actions as the platform's traffic lights: close, minimise and maximise, left to right. Each is a real button with a real name, the marks appear on hover of the cluster, and an action with no handler is disabled rather than dropped so the row never reflows.

items.name: fab
items.title: TonalDepth FloatingActionButton
items.description: A primary action pinned to a corner, and — given a list — a speed dial that grows out of it. Papaya or neutral, up/down/left/right, any of the four corners; built on IconButton so the housing and the lamp are the system's own.

items.name: canvas
items.title: TonalDepth Canvas
items.description: A pannable, zoomable plane and the chrome around it — the housing for a map the reader drives. One transform, so every child stays an ordinary DOM node; a drag never counts as a click; and the camera comes back through the ref so the page can fly to a node when one is opened.

items.name: canvas-panel
items.title: TonalDepth CanvasPanel
items.description: The reading panel that explains what the reader just opened on a Canvas: a head that holds its place, a body that really scrolls, and actions pinned to the foot outside it. Floats over the canvas without a Frame's well flattening it.

items.name: canvas-node
items.title: TonalDepth CanvasNode
items.description: One thing on a Canvas: a card in world space the reader can open. A real button wearing the system's own raised card, with the category edge drawn as a bar rather than an inset shadow — so the card keeps its depth instead of being flattened by its own accent.
